jobs.description:
Business Analyst

Posted on 4 Oct 2026

Deadline on 30 Oct 2026

Apply Now

Explore Jobs

Description

Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi), a software company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, has been successfully providing software services since 2001 in global industry (USA, England, New Zealand, Asia and Africa). We have 280+ employees, with over 250+ skilled Software Engineers & SQA engineers. We continuously invest in hiring, developing, and retaining the best-in-class talents to leverage the latest technologies and offer the most advanced next-gen solutions to our clients. Some of our major projects and products include Nationwide Primary & Secondary Education ERP solutions for Bangladesh Government, Higher Education Management System running in 400+ US universities, Banking Compliance System running in 200+ financial institutions in the USA, 2021 BASIS National ICT Award winning ERP solution for container cargo management of private container yards. At DSi, we work to build state of the art next generation products with the industry's most talented resources.

We are strengthening our Business Analysis team and seeking motivated, analytical, and detail-oriented individuals. This role focuses on requirement analysis, process mapping, documentation, and client engagement across both pre-sales and project delivery stages. Key responsibilities include understanding stakeholder needs, translating them into structured requirements, and ensuring alignment among technical, design, QA, and project teams.
You will work closely with clients, Project Managers, developers, UI/UX teams, QA, and the pre-sales unit to shape project scopes, define system behavior, and support the end-to-end lifecycle - from opportunity assessment to final handover. This position is ideal for individuals who enjoy problem-solving, solution planning, structured documentation, and cross-functional collaboration in dynamic project environments.

Responsibilities

Requirement Analysis & Documentation

• Engage with clients to understand business needs, pain points, and expected outcomes.

• Conduct requirement-gathering meetings, workshops, and site visits as needed.

• Prepare structured requirement artifacts, including: As-Is & To-Be Process Documents, feature Lists, Epics, and User Stories; Inception Reports, UI/UX Flow Documents, etc.

• Develop comprehensive Software Requirements Specifications (SRS) and Software Design Documents (SDD) in collaboration with the Documentation Team.

• Validate processes, flows, and UI/UX designs with clients throughout the analysis phase.

Pre-Sales & Proposal Support

• Participate in scoping exercises, requirement discovery sessions, and early solution framing with Sales and Tech Leads.

• Prepare scoping documents, effort estimations (with Tech Lead support), milestone structures, and risk insights for new opportunities.

• Contribute to RFP/EOI responses by writing technical sections and developing process and architecture diagrams.

Project Execution, Validation & Handover

• Collaborate with PM, Development, QA, and UI/UX teams to maintain clear requirement alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

• Assist Dev and QA teams by providing ongoing clarifications during development and ensuring requirements remain accurate and consistent as the system evolves.

• Engage with clients to facilitate requirement walkthroughs, validations, feedback sessions, and reviews of workflows, prototypes, and To-Be processes.

• Present workflows, prototypes, and To-Be processes to ensure stakeholder alignment.

• Support PMs during key review stages, including UAT, piloting, and deployment.

Requirements

• Excellent communication skills in both English and Bengali, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.

• Ability to structure information logically and produce clear, well-organized documentation.

• Hands-on experience and familiarity with BA documentation, such as SRS, BRD, and As-Is and To-Be process documentation.

• Interest in how software systems work, with a passion for organizing and documenting technical processes.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Sheets, and other productivity or collaboration tools.

• Strong computer literacy and a willingness to quickly learn new technologies and tools.

• Effective time management and multitasking abilities, with experience handling multiple deliverables in parallel.

Preferred

Experience in Government of Bangladesh (GoB) projects is a plus.

Experience Requirement

1–3 Years

Education Qualification

Bachelor’s degree in BBA, CS, CSE, EEE, ETE, or a related field preferred.

Benefits

• Work with some of the best and most experienced talents in the country.

• In-campus free lunch and snacks.

• Festival Bonus: 2

• Weekly holidays: 2 (Friday & Saturday)

• Healthcare Coverage

• Yearly salary increment

• Opportunity to work on international and government-level projects

• Supportive, learning-friendly environment

Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Executive, Ground Operations

Dhaka, Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Saidpur, and Sylhet,
Bangladesh

The country's most preferred airline brand is hiring for the position of “Executive, Ground Operations" under the department of Ground Operations.

 

QUALIFICATION(S):

 

• At least graduate degree in any discipline from any reputed university.

• In Bachelors minimum CGPA 3.00 out of 4.00 and in SSC & HSC minimum GPA 3.00 out of 5.00.

• Third-division or equivalent results in any examination will not be accepted.

• Candidates with English medium (O & A Level) background or foreign degree with Graduation will get preference.

• Flexible to work on various shifts (days, evening, nights, weekends, and holidays).

JOB DESCRIPTIONS:

 

• To seek guideline from the shift In-Charge before commencing tasks.

• Perform check-in duties: verify tickets, issue boarding passes, baggage tag.

• Prepare and verify trim sheets ensure the accuracy of passenger and baggage counts.

• Handle public announcements (paging) as needed.

• Duties in the departure area; check boarding pass and guide the passenger from boarding gate to apron area.

• Support apron operations: supervise passenger and baggage embarkation and disembarkation.

• Duties in the arrival baggage hall to monitor all incoming baggage are on the belt and handed over to passengers accurately.

• Maintain and organize departure and arrival flight documentation.

• Handle mishandled or lost baggage, complete PIRs and ensure prompt delivery to passengers.

• Any other tasks assigned by supervisor from time to time.

 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

 

• Work experience of 0-2 years in the field of Ground Operations/ Customer Service is preferred

• Good communication, interpersonal skill

• Problem solving skill

• Performing high responsibilities

• Supervisory skills

• Good command of spoken and written skills

• Good attitude and able to work hard

• Good command on computer use

• Good leadership and quick decision-making capabilities

 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• At most 28 years (Can be relaxed for deserving candidates)

• Height: Minimum 167.64 cm (5'6") for Male, Minimum 160 cm (5'3") for Female

• Weight: Should be proportionate to Height (BMI: 18-25)

• No affidavit will be accepted

• Eyesight: 6/6, No color blind. Spectacles not accepted (Lasik may be considered for highly deserving candidates)

• Language Skill: Fluent in English & Bengali (both written & spoken)

• Medical Fitness: Good physical health and medically fit to meet Customer Service requirements

• Physical Appearance: Strong, upright; no visible tattoos or marks on the visible part of the body

• Attitude & Bearing: Alluring personality, impressive, decent, and positive gestures

 

SALARY: Negotiable.  

 

JOB LOCATION:Dhaka, Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Saidpur, and Sylhet

 

APPLICATION DEADLINE: 15 October, 2026

 

Eligible candidates are highly encouraged to apply to become a part of the dynamic team of professionals that makes up Air Astra!

 

DISCLAIMER:

1. An application will be null and void if the information provided while applying does not match with the CV.

2. Any attempt to influence or persuade for a position will result in immediate disqualification, regardless of the candidate's qualifications.

3. Please be informed that the recruitment process at Air Astra is completely handled by the airline’s Human Resource Department, and no candidate is ever required to pay any money/fees in any form to pursue any position.

jobs.title: Customer Support Executive - Night Shift
jobs.description:
BRAC IT is seeking Customer Support Executives to deliver first-line, out-of-hours customer operations for a European rail and road freight logistics client. The client's in-house customer care team operates day shifts only, while their trains run 24/7; this role closes that overnight gap. You will be the client's sole customer-facing presence during the European night, handling inbound queries from B2B logistics customers through Zendesk and retrieving shipment, train and terminal information from the client's Oracle-based transport management system (TMS). The role is predominantly written, ticket-based communication against defined service levels, with a structured handover into the client's morning shift.
Department:

Sales

Employment Type:

Full-time

Experience:

1-3 Years

Workplace Type:

Online

Number of Vacancies:

2

Location:

Dhaka

Deadline:

15 October 2026

Key Responsibilities

First-Line Ticket Handling
- Monitor and respond to inbound customer tickets in Zendesk throughout the overnight window
- Acknowledge, triage and resolve queries within agreed SLA response and resolution times
- Categorise, prioritise and tag tickets accurately for downstream reporting
Maintain complete, accurate case notes on every ticket
System Lookup & Information Accuracy
- Retrieve shipment, train, trailer and terminal status information from the client's Oracle based TMS
- Cross-verify information across systems before responding — accuracy takes precedence over speed
- Identify and flag data gaps, stale records or system inconsistencies to the client's onshore team
Escalation & Handover
-Escalate issues beyond first-line scope in line with the agreed escalation matrix
- Distinguish clearly between what can be resolved overnight and what must wait for the client's day shift
- Execute a structured shift handover covering open, escalated and pending cases at the start of the client's morning shift
Knowledge & Process Discipline
- Follow documented standard operating procedures precisely
- Contribute to and maintain knowledge base articles, macros and response templates in Zendesk
- Surface recurring issues, process friction and automation candidates to the BRAC IT team lead
Service Quality & Reporting
- Meet defined quality standards on tone, accuracy and completeness of written customer responses
- Support periodic service reporting on ticket volumes, response times and recurring themes
- Participate in calibration and quality review sessions with the BRAC IT team lead

Required Skills & Experience

• Education : Bachelor's degree in any discipline

• Certification in customer service, ITIL Foundation, or a comparable service-management qualification is a plus (not mandatory)

• 1–3 years of experience in customer support, service desk, BPO or shared-services operations

• Excellent written English — this is the single most important screening criterion; the role is almost entirely written communication with European business customers, requiring clear, professional, concise prose

• Willingness and ability to work permanent night shifts

• Demonstrated ability to work across multiple systems simultaneously and follow documented processes precisely

• Strong attention to detail and a verify-before-responding mindset

• Composure and sound judgement when working unsupervised during overnight hours

• Hands-on experience with Zendesk, Freshdesk, ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing platform

• Prior experience supporting international clients, particularly in Europe

• Background in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain or transportation

• Working knowledge of Italian or French (the client has indicated these are more useful to them than German; English alone is sufficient to start)

• Familiarity with SLA-driven service delivery and basic service metrics

• Exposure to ERP or transport management systems

•

• Age At least 30 years

• Proven experience in technical project management.

• Knowledge in version control techniques and configuration management.

• Knowledge in standard quality model and IT governance framework.

• Self-directed, excellent analysis and judgment skills

• Ability to work well independently and in a team environment.

• Ensure that all projects are delivered on-time, within scope and within budget.

• Use appropriate verification techniques to manage changes in project scope, schedule, and costs.

• Define and measure project performance metrices using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques.

• Report and escalate project status to management as needed.

• Perform risk management strategies to minimize project risks.

• Establish and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders like clients/third parties/vendors.

• Ensure project quality and contribute to developing detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.

• Collaborate with cross functional team to determine and establish best practices.

Senior Executive/Assistant Manager; Transmission (NTTN)

Published on Sep 13, 2026

Job Context

• Manage the complete lifecycle of NTTN and LSP connectivity, including survey, feasibility assessment, deployment, commissioning, bandwidth upgrade/downgrade, service modification, and service discontinuation.

• Coordinate with NTTN vendors, including Summit Communications, Fiber@Home, and Bahon Limited, LSP providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely implementation, smooth operations, effective troubleshooting, and prompt issue escalation.

• Follow up on NTTN and LSP surveys, feasibility assessments, link implementation, and commissioning activities, ensuring timely completion in line with operational requirements.

• Maintain regular communication with vendors and internal teams to ensure timely troubleshooting, service restoration, operational continuity, and effective issue escalation.

• Prepare and submit daily operational reports covering installation, survey, commissioning, troubleshooting, and other connectivity-related activities.

• Prepare and submit monthly performance, commissioning, capacity utilization, and billing reports to support management decision-making, operational governance, and cost control.

• Ensure all NTTN and LSP activities are carried out in accordance with company policies, operational procedures, service requirements, and agreed timelines.

About the Role

CarryBee Express Ltd. is looking for a responsible and proactive Night Shift Operations Lead to oversee night-time sorting, parcel movement, dispatch, manpower utilization, and overall operational activities at its Central Sort facility. The role requires strong leadership, problem-solving, coordination, and accountability to ensure smooth operations and timely parcel dispatch.

Key Responsibilities

Supervise and manage Central Sort Operations throughout the full night shift.

Ensure proper parcel sorting, scanning, movement, handover, and dispatch.

Ensure timely and accurate dispatch of parcels within defined operational timelines.

Monitor team performance, productivity, attendance, backlog, and overall shift activities.

Allocate manpower effectively and ensure proper utilization of available resources.

Manage operational challenges and make timely, appropriate decisions when required.

Identify operational issues and coordinate with relevant teams and personnel for quick resolution.

Maintain team discipline, productivity, accountability, and day-to-day operational performance.

Support people sourcing and manpower planning based on operational demand and shift requirements.

Prepare and share management reports on operational performance, dispatch status, backlog, and critical issues.

Maintain effective communication and coordination with management and relevant cross-functional teams.

Ensure compliance with company SOPs, operational standards, service quality requirements, and defined timelines.

Take ownership of operational challenges and ensure proper follow-up until resolution.

Maintain honesty, integrity, accountability, and professionalism in all operational activities.

Perform any other operational responsibilities assigned by management.

Educational Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or graduation in Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or any relevant discipline from a recognized university.

BBA/MBA in Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field will be preferred.

Experience Requirements

Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience in courier, logistics, e-commerce, delivery, warehouse, or related operations.

Previous experience in a supervisory or team-lead role will be preferred.

Candidates with relevant experience in the courier and logistics industry will receive preference.

Additional Requirements

Age: 26–34 years

Good understanding of courier and logistics operations, parcel movement, sorting, and dispatch processes.

Strong team management and leadership skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

Ability to handle operational challenges and work effectively under pressure.

Good communication, coordination, and reporting skills.

Strong time management and organizational skills.

Ability to manage manpower and support people sourcing according to operational requirements.

Honest, responsible, disciplined, proactive, and accountable.

Comfortable working in a full night-shift environment.

Ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment and meet defined timelines.

2 Festival/Eid Bonuses per year

Yearly salary increment based on company policy and performance

Promotion opportunities based on performance and eligibility

Dormitory facility

Night snacks

On-site at the CarryBee Warehouse, Balur Bridge, Madani Avenue, Beraid, Badda, Dhaka-1212, Bangladesh.

Job Purpose

Manage import operations, commercial documentation, logistics coordination, customs clearance support, and supplier follow-up to ensure timely, cost-effective delivery of imported goods.

Key Responsibilities

Process import procurement activities from purchase order to final delivery.

Coordinate with overseas suppliers, freight forwarders, banks, and C&F agents.

Handle L/C, TT, UPAS L/C, deferred payment, and other trade finance instruments.

Review shipping documents and ensure compliance with import regulations.

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, International Business, Business Administration, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline.

MBA/Master’s degree preferred.

3–5 years of experience in import, commercial, and logistics operations.

Experience in handling international procurement and import documentation.

Additional Requirements

Strong knowledge of international trade and shipping procedures.

Understanding of Bangladesh Customs and import regulations.

Knowledge of Incoterms 2020 and international logistics.

jobs.description:
Location: Banani, Dhaka, BangladeshOffice Location: House 9, Block L, Road 1/B, Chairman Bari, Banani, Dhaka-1213Employment Type: Full-timeContract Type: 2 Years (Renewable)Vacancy: 01Salary: BDT 25,000–30,000 per monthOffice Hours: 8:00 AM-5:00 PM, Sunday–ThursdayApplication Deadline: 20 October 2026

About JAAGO Foundation

JAAGO Foundation is a civil society organization (CSO) working towards education and social mobilization for the underprivileged masses of Bangladesh. Its mission is to fight poverty. JAAGO pioneered a Free-of-Cost International Standard School for underprivileged children in remote areas of Bangladesh.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure effective teaching practices by reviewing lesson plans, instructional materials, teaching aids, and their alignment with curriculum standards.

Conduct regular classroom observations, physical and/or virtual, to assess teaching quality, instructional delivery, and student engagement.

Monitor student learning progress using assessment data, grade averages, and performance trends; identify underperforming students and support appropriate interventions.

Review assessment records, including chapter-end assessments, class tests, half-yearly, yearly, term, and other significant summative examinations, and provide timely feedback and reports for academic improvement planning.

Ensure teachers complete assigned academic tasks and additional responsibilities, including implementation of supporting guidelines and required training.

Monitor and verify teachers’ and school staff’s attendance, punctuality, and adherence to professional responsibilities.

Track student attendance patterns and collaborate with relevant teams to maintain attendance rates at or above 80%.

Ensure learning environments, instructional tools, and communication channels are maintained according to program guidelines and standards.

Provide monitoring and guidance to ensure smooth implementation of school and program activities.

Assist in planning and implementing co-curricular activities, national observances, and academic events in coordination with relevant teams.

Ensure academic deliverables, including teaching materials, teaching aids, question papers, assessment schedules, grading, result compilation, parent meetings, and report card days, are completed accurately and on time.

Provide guidance and support to address challenges raised by teachers or school teams where applicable.

Report needs or issues to the Supervisor, Administration, and HR teams to ensure smooth program implementation.

Maintain accurate and organized documentation of academic reports, class observations, need-based assessments and grades, teacher feedback and performance records, and student progress data as directed by the Supervisor.

Perform other academic or program-related duties assigned by the Supervisor or required by the organization in support of institutional goals.

Promote and maintain a safe, inclusive, and child-friendly learning environment across all schools through training, content, and other activities.

Ensure all educational practices and content adhere to JAAGO Foundation’s Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct.

Incorporate gender-sensitive and inclusive approaches in all teaching and monitoring activities.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Education, Sciences, Commerce, or a relevant discipline.

Additional training or certification in pedagogy, assessment, teacher development, or education leadership will be considered an advantage.

Experience

Minimum 1-2 years of teaching experience or training in primary and/or secondary education with strong subject knowledge.

Experience in coaching SSC batches will be an advantage.

Related work experience will be considered an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of curriculum alignment, lesson planning, and classroom pedagogy.

Ability to analyze assessment data, identify learning gaps, and recommend actionable interventions.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills to coach, mentor, and support teachers effectively.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and school follow-ups simultaneously.

Ability to work collaboratively across teams and maintain professional accountability.

Digital literacy and comfort using Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, and Slides, communication platforms, and basic data-tracking tools.

Compensation & Benefits

Provident Fund

Bonuses

2 days’ weekly holiday

Friendly working environment

• The ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct English reports is crucial.

• Critical thinking and problem solving ability

• Skilled in communicating findings to senior management, board committees, and regulators.

• Strong skills in managing multiple audits, timelines, and cross-functional engagements.

Responsibilities & Context

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of risk-based audit plans, audit universe, risk registers, and risk assessment frameworks to ensure audit coverage remains aligned with the organization`s key risks, strategic priorities, and governance objectives.

• Support the Internal Audit function in fulfilling its responsibilities in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter, IIA Standards, Code of Ethics, organizational policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements while contributing to the continuous enhancement of audit effectiveness and value delivery.

• Maintain professional independence, objectivity, and integrity in all audit activities; promptly disclose any actual or perceived impairment thereof and exercise sound professional judgment by making balanced assessments based on relevant facts, evidence, and circumstances.

• Maintain a thorough understanding of audit methodologies, emerging risks, industry trends, regulatory developments, business strategies, processes, systems, and the broader operating environment relevant to the organization.

• Plan, execute, and document audit engagements by defining objectives, scope, timelines, resource requirements, and risk considerations, ensuring alignment with approved methodologies, departmental standards, and organizational priorities.

• Independently identify, analyze, evaluate, and document sufficient and appropriate audit evidence to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes.

• Develop and maintain audit frameworks, assessment criteria, risk and control matrices (RCMs), and other engagement-level documentation required to support audit conclusions and recommendations.

• Evaluate the potential impact of significant errors, fraud, misconduct, and regulatory non-compliance, and perform audit procedures with due professional care and professional skepticism.

• Prepare and communicate accurate, objective, clear, concise, constructive, complete, and timely audit reports, while collaborating with auditees and management to develop practical corrective action plans and facilitate timely resolution of identified issues.

• Ensure audit engagements adequately address key risks, identify control gaps and business process improvement opportunities, assess strategic and operational implications, and provide practical recommendations to strengthen governance, risk management, and internal controls.

• Conduct periodic follow-up reviews, maintain issue-tracking mechanisms, monitor implementation of agreed action plans, and escalate significant unresolved issues or instances where management’s acceptance of risk may exceed the organization’s risk appetite.

• Coordinate with management, process owners, and other assurance, compliance, risk, and monitoring functions to obtain business understanding, maximize audit coverage, leverage assurance activities, and minimize duplication of effort.

• Review and evaluate the work of other assurance providers, where appropriate, to support effective utilization of audit resources and reliance on relevant assurance activities.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships across the organization and serve as a trusted business partner in promoting effective controls, risk awareness, and continuous process improvement.

• Provide support to supervisors and the Head of Internal Audit on functional, administrative, and other departmental matters as required.

• Hands-on experience in execution of court decrees, warrants, attachment and auction of mortgaged properties and taking over the possession of Bank’s owned property and recall the warrant through court.

• Experience in dealing with Classified Loans (NPLs).

Responsibilities & Context

Prime Bank PLC. is one of the leading private commercial banks of the country and proud recipient of numerous local and international awards for published accounts & reports, operational excellence, and industry leadership. We are looking for qualified and experienced candidates for the position of Law Officer, Warrant Execution & Asset Recovery Unit, Legal Division.

Job Grade: SO - FAVP

• Take necessary step to forward the Order of Warrant of Arrest from the concerned court to the concerned Police Station timely.

• Collect the present address of the Customer from SAMD.

• Engage and supervise labors; arranging transportation; printing, preparing and displaying signboards on the scheduled property; and procuring red cloth, locks and any other materials required for the execution and completion of the possession process.

jobs.title: Manager - Cost & Budget
jobs.description:
Quazi Enterprises Ltd. | Finance & Accounts | Dhaka (Savar)Reporting To: Head of Finance & Accounts

About the Role

Quazi Enterprises Ltd. is looking for a dynamic and experienced Manager – Cost & Budget to join its Finance & Accounts team. The role requires strong expertise in Cost Accounting, Budgeting, Financial Analysis, and Product Costing, with relevant experience in the FMCG/Toiletries industry.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct regular pre-costing and post-costing analysis for all products, including BOM-based standard costing and variance analysis against actuals.

Perform monthly inventory valuation and reconcile with financial records.

Lead the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts for all departments.

Monitor budget utilization and highlight variances with corrective recommendations.

Review factory operations to identify inefficiencies and eliminate non-value-added costs.

Conduct feasibility studies and financial analysis for new products and business initiatives.

Analyze product-, brand-, channel-, and customer-wise profitability (segment margin) and provide insights for margin improvement.

Identify and monitor break-even points for products and operations.

Evaluate the cost impact of trade spend, promotions, and schemes on net margin, in coordination with Sales and Marketing.

Prepare and compile the company’s annual financial budget.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including Production, Supply Chain, and Sales, to ensure cost efficiency and financial discipline.

Strengthen internal controls and ensure compliance with company policies and financial regulations.

Continuously improve costing systems, tools, and reporting processes for better decision support.

Prepare and present financial and analytical reports for the Board of Directors (BOD), as required.

Perform any other duties or responsibilities as assigned by Management from time to time.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business.

Part-qualified or qualified CMA, CA, or ACCA is strongly preferred.

Experience Requirements

5–8 years of progressive experience in cost accounting, budgeting, and financial analysis, with at least 3 years in FMCG, preferably in Toiletries.

Demonstrated hands-on experience in product costing (standard and actual), BOM-based costing, and variance analysis.

Strong knowledge of Financial Analysis & Cost Management.

Experience in Budgeting & Forecasting.

Experience in Cost Accounting & Inventory Management.

Experience in segment margin, channel, and customer profitability analysis.

Experience in Financial Modeling & Feasibility Analysis.

Key Deliverables

Accurate product costing, BOM maintenance, and cost variance analysis to support pricing and profitability decisions.

Monthly inventory valuation and variance analysis for financial accuracy and control.

Preparation and compilation of annual and periodic budgets across all functions, aligned with organizational goals.

Identification of non-value-added costs and implementation of cost-reduction opportunities.

Product, channel, and customer profitability, break-even, and financial analysis to support Management and Board-level decision-making.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to send their updated CV to: Email: hr@qel-groupqa.com

Department: Group FinanceJob Level: Deputy ManagerReports To: Group Finance ControllerLocation: Dhaka, BangladeshExperience: 6–8 years

About the Role

Rancon Holdings Ltd. is looking for an experienced finance professional for the position of Deputy Manager – Financial Analysis & Reporting within its Group Finance team. The incumbent will support timely and accurate Group-level financial reporting by consolidating financial data across business units, ensuring compliance with accounting standards and Group policies, and providing financial analysis to support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Consolidate financial statements across multiple business units in line with Group reporting timelines.

Support monthly, quarterly, and annual closing, financial submissions, and timely Group-level financial reports.

Ensure financial reporting complies with IFRS/local GAAP, accounting standards, and internal accounting policies.

Analyse performance, variances, and trends across business units and provide insights for management decisions.

Monitor intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and balances, ensuring proper elimination during consolidation.

Prepare management reports, dashboards, analyses, and presentations, including ad hoc requests.

Coordinate with business-unit Finance teams to validate data, resolve discrepancies, and improve reporting systems, processes, and data quality.

jobs.title: Manager, EHS
jobs.description:
SMC ENTERPRISE LTD

CAREER OPPORTUNITY

 

SMC Enterprise Ltd has a vacancy for the following permanent position:

POSITION TITLE: MANAGER, EHS

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Strategic EHS Leadership

• Develop and execute the organization's EHS strategy aligned with corporate objectives and operational priorities.

• Establish a robust EHS governance framework covering all manufacturing plants, warehouses, logistics operations, and corporate offices.

• Drive a culture of safety excellence, environmental responsibility, and continuous improvement across the organization.

• Serve as the principal advisor to the CPOO and senior management on all EHS matters.

• Lead organizational initiatives aimed at achieving world-class EHS performance.

2. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure compliance with all applicable Bangladesh environmental, occupational health and safety, fire safety, labor, transportation, and industrial regulations.

• Monitor changes in legal and regulatory requirements and ensure timely implementation across all locations.

• Develop and maintain compliance registers, permits, licenses, and statutory reporting requirements.

• Lead enterprise-wide EHS risk assessments and mitigation programs.

• Ensure compliance with customers and stakeholders EHS requirements where applicable.

3. Occupational Health & Safety Management

• Develop and implement safety management systems, standards, procedures, and safe work practices.

• Establish programs for hazard identification, risk assessment, incident prevention, and behavior-based safety.

• Lead investigations of serious incidents, near misses, and occupational injuries to determine root causes and preventive actions.

• Monitor workplace safety performance through audits, inspections, observations, and leading indicators.

• Ensure effective contractor safety management programs are implemented across all sites.

• Promote employee engagement and participation in workplace safety initiatives.

4. Environmental Management & Sustainability

• Develop and implement environmental management programs to minimize environmental impact.

• Oversee waste management, emissions control, resource efficiency, pollution prevention, and environmental compliance programs.

• Monitor environmental performance metrics and recommend improvement initiatives.

• Support sustainability initiatives related to energy efficiency, water conservation, waste reduction, and climate-related objectives.

• Ensure environmental permits and reporting obligations are effectively managed.

5. Manufacturing and Operational EHS Oversight

• Provide direct EHS oversight into all manufacturing facilities and support functions.

• Ensure consistent implementation of EHS standards across all factories and operational sites.

• Conduct periodic site reviews, audits, and management inspections.

• Support operational leaders in integrating EHS requirements into production, maintenance, engineering, and quality processes.

• Ensuring process safety and machine safety programs are effectively implemented.

6. Warehouse, Logistics & Transportation Safety

• Establish EHS standards for warehouse operations, fleet management, transportation activities, and distribution networks.

• Ensure safe handling, storage, and transportation of raw materials, chemicals, and finished products.

• Implement road safety and defensive driving programs.

• Monitor contractor and third-party logistics safety performance.

7. Emergency Preparedness & Business Continuity

• Develop and maintain emergency response plans for all facilities and offices.

• Coordinate emergency preparedness drills, fire safety programs, evacuation exercises, and crisis response activities.

• Liaise with government authorities, fire service, hospitals, and emergency response agencies.

• Support business continuity planning from an EHS perspective.

8. EHS Management Systems & Certifications

• Lead the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of EHS management systems.

• Manage certification and surveillance audits related to ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and other applicable standards.

• Ensure timely closure of audit findings and corrective actions.

9. Training, Awareness & Culture Development

• Develop and implement annual EHS training and competency development programs.

• Ensure all employees, contractors, and visitors receive appropriate EHS orientation and training.

• Promote awareness campaigns, safety communications, and leadership engagement programs.

• Coach and mentor operational leaders to strengthen EHS ownership and accountability.

10. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

• Establish EHS KPIs and performance dashboards for management review.

• Analyze incident trends, audit findings, risk data, and compliance indicators.

• Prepare periodic reports for the CPOO, Executive Management Team, and Board-level review as required.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on performance analysis.

11. Team Leadership

• Lead, develop, and supervise the factory-based EHS Officers and other EHS personnel.

• Ensure consistent implementation of EHS standards across all operational locations.

• Conduct performance management, coaching, succession planning, and capability development for the EHS team.

• Foster collaboration between EHS, Operations, Engineering, HR, Supply Chain, Quality, and Administration functions.

12. Predictive Risk & Hazard Management

• Utilize AI predictive analytics and machine learning models to analyze incident trends, near-misses, and behavioral data to forecast potential accidents before they occur.

• Implement IoT-enabled wearable devices and smart sensors for real-time monitoring of work environments (e.g., hazardous gas leaks, heat stress, unsafe noise levels, and fatigue).

• Deploy AI-assisted computer vision via existing CCTV networks to conduct continuous, automated monitoring of PPE compliance and restrict access to high-risk zones

13. Digital Compliance & Reporting

• Manage automated compliance tracking and generate real-time ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) and safety performance dashboards to replace manual reporting.

• Ensure the ethical and compliant deployment of AI safety tools, ensuring data privacy for employees and adherence to governance standards.

• Transition traditional, manual facility audits into AI-augmented inspections that rapidly process large datasets and images.

14. Innovation & Safety Culture

• Champion continuous improvement by integrating emerging digital tools into the company’s HSE Management Systems (ISO 45001 & ISO 14001).

• Oversee "human-in-the-loop" governance—ensuring complex incident investigations and critical interventions are managed by safety professionals with AI support, rather than automated entirely.

• Develop training and competency frameworks that leverage virtual reality (VR) and personalized AI-driven safety modules for the workforce.

15. Any other task assigned by the Management.

REQUIREMENTS:

Education: BSc in Mechanical/Electrical/Chemical/Industrial Engineering/Occupational Health and Safety/ Environmental Science.

Experience: At least 10 years

Knowledge

Practical knowledge on firefighting, safety, internal audit and safety audit, risk perception and able to work on stress.

Technical Skills

• NEBOSH (IGC)/ Behavioral Based Safety

• ISO 45001 & 14001

Soft Skills: Good leadership and interpersonal skill, excellent communication skills, exceptional change management, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to influence a digital-first safety culture.

Age: Maximum 45 years

Criteria may be relaxed for highly deserving candidates.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager, Research and Operations, Otithi
jobs.description:
job purpose

BRAC-Otithi aims to transform tourism in Bangladesh by connecting urban generations with rural communities, uncovering hidden cultural and natural treasures. The initiative focuses on celebrating and preserving local traditions while empowering communities through sustainable tourism. By showcasing the beauty of unexplored areas, BRAC-Otithi seeks to create unforgettable journeys for both local and foreign travellers.

The Deputy Manager, Research & Field Operations is responsible for ensuring consistent and high-quality execution of Otithi’s field operations across destinations, B2B trips, festivals, day trips and other tourism experiences. The role coordinates Area Managers, Assistant Area Managers, tour guides, community partners and other field stakeholders, while strengthening guest experience, community engagement and operational efficiency. The role also contributes to research, destination development and product improvement in collaboration with the Manager, Business Development.

key responsibilities

Field Operations & Service Quality:

• Ensure smooth and consistent trip execution by coordinating with Area Managers, Assistant Area Managers, guides, community partners, vendors, and other field stakeholders and resolving operational issues on time.

• Monitor guest experience and operational quality by tracking customer feedback, service standards, field performance, and operational risks and implementing appropriate improvements.

Team & Community Engagement:

• Strengthen field capacity and operational readiness by supporting the onboarding, training, and development of Area Managers, Assistant Area Managers, guides, and other relevant field resources.

• Manage community and destination-level partnerships by maintaining relationships with local stakeholders and coordinating community welfare, development, and impact initiatives across Otithi destinations.

Operational & Financial Management:

• Coordinate operational and financial planning for trips and destinations by supporting costing and COGS planning, monitoring field-level expenses and settlements, and analysing cost variances to improve efficiency and product margins.

Product Development & Innovation:

• Customise and improve Otithi products and itineraries by incorporating client requirements, destination capacity, operational feasibility, guest feedback, and field learning into pricing and experience design.

• Support new destination and product development by conducting field assessments, destination research, and community consultations and contributing to feasibility assessments, itinerary development, pricing, and pilot experiences.

• Drive continuous operational and product innovation by identifying and testing new experience formats, analysing market and guest insights, and applying operational and community learning to existing and new offerings.

Responsible & Ethical Tourism:

• Ensure responsible and ethical tourism practices by integrating safeguarding, cultural sensitivity, informed participation, privacy, community dignity, responsible use of cultural knowledge, and environmental responsibility into field operations.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Initiatives & Frugal Innovation Forum, Social Innovation Lab
jobs.description:
job purpose

To deliver BRAC's flagship strategic initiatives including the Frugal Innovation Forum (Conference, Innovation Challenge, and Fellowship) and BRAC X consistently and with high quality, contributing to BRAC's 2026–2030 strategy and its goal of developing innovative solutions to evolving social challenges. The role creates value by running the FIF cycle end to end, applying standard processes to the FIF Innovation Challenge and Fellowship, moving staff ideas from BRAC Idea Capture into BRAC X, and coordinating partners, sponsors, judges, and mentors, supporting SIL's role in amplifying innovation across BRAC.

key responsibilities

A. Frugal Innovation Forum delivery

• Act as the FIF Secretariat, leading end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery of the Frugal Innovation Forum (FIF) biennial cycle — Conference, Innovation Challenge, and Fellowship — ensuring a coherent, high-quality experience across the cycle.

• Establish and manage a standard operating process for the FIF Innovation Challenge — covering call, submissions, judging, shortlisting, and awards — so that the Challenge runs consistently as an institutionalised component of every FIF cycle rather than a one-off exercise.

• Establish and manage a standard operating process for the FIF Fellowship — covering selection, onboarding, mentoring support, and delivery milestones — so that the Fellowship runs consistently as an institutionalised component of every FIF cycle.

• Manage the idea pipelines that feed these initiatives, such as the BRAC Idea Capture initiative, which channels early-stage staff ideas into BRAC X, ensuring a smooth pathway from submission through to intrapreneurship.

• Manage relationships with partners of the FIF and other strategic initiatives — including sponsors, judges, mentors, and collaborating institutions — ensuring partnership commitments are met and relationships are well maintained.

jobs.title: Programme Head; Climate and Environmental Innovation Programme
jobs.description:
job purpose

Provide strategic and technical leadership to BRAC’s Climate and Environmental Innovation Programme (CEIP) by driving the development, validation, scaling, and institutional integration of evidence-based climate and environmental solutions. Lead CEIP’s innovation portfolio, strategic partnerships, knowledge and evidence generation, resource mobilisation, and technical teams to strengthen BRAC’s climate resilience and environmental impact, influence sectoral and policy discourse, and enable the sustainable adoption and scale-up of innovative solutions across BRAC programmes, enterprises, and external platforms.

key responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Programme Oversight:

• Provide strategic and technical leadership to CEIP’s climate and environmental innovation portfolio, ensuring scientific rigor, programme quality, strategic alignment, scale, and measurable impact across the innovation cycle. 

• Guide the development and implementation of strategic priorities, approaches, and delivery models for CEIP’s climate and environmental interventions.

• Provide overall oversight of CEIP’s technical teams and innovative interventions, ensuring effective coordination, delivery, performance, and alignment with organisational priorities. 

Innovation, Scaling & Institutional Integration:

• Lead the development, validation, transformation, and scaling of evidence-based and context-specific solutions across climate adaptation and mitigation, climate-resilient agriculture, water security, environmental management, Nature-based Solutions (NbS), low-carbon technologies, waste management, and the circular economy. 

• Lead collaboration with BRAC programmes and enterprises, including MF, BRAC Enterprises, IDP, UPG, ICCP, Aarong, and other relevant platforms, to mainstream and scale proven climate and environmental solutions within existing programme and business models. 

Strategic Partnerships & External Influence:

• Build and lead strategic partnerships with government agencies, universities, research institutions, private sector actors, development partners, and national and international networks to strengthen BRAC’s technical leadership and influence in climate and environmental action. 

• Represent BRAC and position CEIP as a credible technical and thought leader through strategic engagement in national, regional, and international forums, platforms, and policy processes. 

Evidence, Knowledge & Learning:

• Lead the generation, validation, documentation, and dissemination of evidence, innovations, knowledge, and learning through technical forums, publications, policy engagement, and knowledge platforms to support replication, institutional agreement, and wider scaling. 

• Oversee the development and implementation of robust qualitative and quantitative monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks to assess the effectiveness, outcomes, scalability, and impact of CEIP’s interventions. 

Resource Mobilisation & Programme Sustainability:

• Lead the identification of emerging opportunities, development of innovative concepts, and engagement with potential partners and donors to strengthen CEIP’s programme portfolio and financial sustainability. 

• Identify opportunities for replication, institutional uptake, strategic partnerships, resource mobilisation, and wider scaling of proven BRAC solutions. 

• Contribute to the development of new funding and partnership models that support the long-term sustainability and expansion of CEIP’s climate and environmental initiatives.

People Leadership & Team Capability:

• Provide strategic oversight of workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, succession planning, and capability development to ensure CEIP has the right talent, expertise, and leadership capacity to deliver its strategic priorities. 

• Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and professional excellence, while strengthening team effectiveness and cross-functional collaboration.

safeguarding responsibilities

• Establish a safeguarding culture across all levels of the programme by implementing the safeguarding policy. Act as a key source of support, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment. 

• Responsible to ensure team members are appropriately trained, supported and have access to resources regarding issues that are identified and implemented in accordance with the safeguarding policy and procedure. 

• Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place and encourage others to do so.

Department: Product

Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time

Enosis Outsourcing is a global software outsourcing marketplace that helps businesses discover, evaluate, and shortlist software development and QA partners.

We are looking for an experienced Organic Traffic & Growth Manager to lead organic search performance and AI-driven visibility across enosisoutsourcing.com and its blog. We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who will drive software delivery efficiency by implementing and optimizing DevOps practices. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to automate infrastructure, manage cloud resources, and ensure system scalability, security, and reliability. Leveraging expertise in CI/CD, networking, cloud technologies, containerization, and monitoring tools, the role will deliver impactful solutions and foster continuous improvement.

Introduction

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join the Strategy and Value Consulting (SVC) team at Optimizely. This role owns the data foundation behind our value consulting work: the source mapping, the models, the tables, and the analyses that our benchmarks, value models, and published research are all built on. 

 

Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, you'll be the person who makes distributed, messy data usable. You'll map source systems, model them into analysis-ready tables, and run the complex analyses that turn raw product and customer data into numbers we can defend in front of an enterprise buyer. The three biggest parts of this job are mapping and modeling our data sources, building and maintaining the datasets the team runs on, and performing the deep analyses behind our benchmarks and research. 

 

This is a hands-on technical role, not a writing one. Our research and thought leadership are authored by a dedicated member of the team who depends on your work: you own the data and the analysis, and they own the narrative. What we need from you is rigor, reproducibility, and the ability to answer a hard question with data nobody has organized yet. 

Job Responsibilities

Data Mapping and Modeling: 

• Map and document our data landscape — product usage, customer, CRM, and third-party sources — including schemas, definitions, grain, coverage, and known quality issues 

• Design and build analysis-ready tables and data models the wider team can query without re-deriving logic every time 

• Establish and maintain consistent metric definitions so the same question returns the same answer across dashboards, value models, and published research 

• Own data quality: validation, reconciliation against source systems, and monitoring for breaks 

Data Engineering and Operationalization:

• Build and maintain repeatable pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from a variety of sources, including APIs, flat files, and third-party datasets 

• Turn one-off analyses into maintained datasets with automated refreshes 

• Optimize queries and models for performance against large tables 

• Document transformation logic end to end so any published number can be traced back to source 

Analysis: 

• Perform complex analyses on large datasets: segmentation, cohort and time-series analysis, significance testing, correlation, and regression 

• Produce the quantitative foundation for industry benchmarks, maturity models, and industry-specific value models 

• Supply the datasets, analyses, and methodology notes behind our white papers and research reports, partnering with the team member who writes them 

Dashboards and Reporting: 

• Create and maintain dashboards for internal use, focused on customer benchmarks, performance metrics, and presales reporting 

• Build reporting stakeholders can self-serve, rather than re-requesting the same cut of data 

• Be the team's go-to resource for all data needs 

Collaboration and Communication: 

• Work with internal stakeholders to identify key data requirements and make sure data is accurate and consistent 

• Partner with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Revenue Operations) to get access to the data we need and to understand how it's generated 

• Explain methodology, assumptions, and caveats clearly to non-technical stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior Maintenance Officer
jobs.description:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to ensure better health in more hands, everyday. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Supply Chain [Manufacturing]

Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen. If you're looking for a career in supply chain/ manufacturing, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers.

About the role

In this role, you will ensure the reliable and efficient operation and maintenance of critical engineering assets and utilities across the factory, including HVAC, generators, water treatment, chillers, compressed air systems, and lifting equipment. You will drive preventive maintenance, asset optimization, energy monitoring, calibration, and engineering projects while coordinating contractors and vendors. The role is also responsible for engineering CAPA and ensuring operations comply with Reckitt’s Health & Safety, Environmental, Quality, legal, and compliance requirements. 

Your responsibilities

• Implement operations and maintenance programs for engineering assets.

• Operate, maintain, and monitor generators.

• Plan and execute regular maintenance of factory HVAC systems.

• Operate and monitor the water treatment plant.

• Operate, maintain, and monitor industrial chillers.

• Maintain and monitor air compressors, air dryers, and vacuum systems.

• Ensure the smooth operation of stability chambers.

• Ensure the smooth operation of cargo lifts and scissor lifts.

• Manage and coordinate engineering projects, contractors, AMCs, and ARCs.

• Manage engineering CAPAs related to Safety, Quality, Legal, and Compliance requirements.

• Prepare BOQs and coordinate vendor selection, design approval, and installation.

• Manage maintenance SOPs.

• Regularly monitor energy consumption, including electricity and water.

• Ensure optimal asset management to reduce costs, increase productivity, and minimize downtime.

• Ensure the calibration of all measuring equipment.

• Ensure compliance with all RB H&S standards, legal requirements, HIRA requirements, and relevant workplace safety requirements.

• Ensure compliance with all RB Environmental standards, environmental aspects and impacts, legal requirements, and other relevant workplace environmental requirements.

The experience & education background we're looking for

• Minimum 3 years of working experience specifically in HVAC systems (Utility).

• Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.

We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sex; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Ding is the global leader in cross-border value transfer. Since 2006, we’ve moved more than $6BN across borders — putting money directly into the hands of diaspora communities so they can support the families they left behind. Today, we operate in 160+ countries, partner with 600+ mobile operators, and serve some of the world’s most underserved markets with technology that is fast, reliable and genuinely life changing. 

 

We’re headquartered in Dublin and built by a team of 200+ people spread across the globe — engineers, operators and product thinkers who believe that moving value across borders should be as simple as sending a message. 

 

We move fast, build with purpose, and hold ourselves to four values:

• We are Thinkers, Linkers & Doers 

• We Win Together 

• We Imagine Boldly & Build Fast 

 

THE ROLE: 

Job Title: Principal Web Engineer/Senior Web Engineer

Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh 
Type of Contract: Full Time Employee 
Salary Range: Negotiable 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're on the lookout for a talented web developer - someone who's curious, collaborative, and excited about building world-class web experiences.

You'll join a close-knit team of web engineers and work alongside folks in Product, Data, QA, and Design. Together, you'll help shape and deliver the next generation of our web applications, used by people all over the world.

We're hands-on here, and this role is no different. You'll be right in the thick of it - writing clean, scalable code with React and .NET, contributing to architecture decisions, and helping us keep our tech standards high. You'll also have a voice in how we improve our ways of working, and we'll welcome your ideas on tools, frameworks, and best practices.

If you're someone who loves solving problems, cares about users, and wants to be part of a team where your input matters - we'd love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Building out performant web applications using modern React and .NET technology

• Being part of a highly effective team using Kanban methodologies

• Work with exciting technologies (React, .NET, CI/CD pipelines)

• Implement and maintain CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth deployments

• Optimize application performance and ensure best practices are followed

• Implement SEO best practices to maximize visibility and user reach

• Be part of the whole lifecycle of a feature; from the idea to discussion with the business, delivery, releasing to production

• Belong to a team who are constantly thinking about efficiency through good practices

• Participate and be listened to on discussion about new features, refactor opportunities, team improvements, new techs etc.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

• At least 5 years of professional experience in web development using React.

• At least 1 year of professional experience with .NET framework.

• Strong team player skills

• Knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience implementing automated pipelines.

• Strong understanding of web performance best practices including optimization techniques, lazy loading, code splitting, and bundle optimization.

• Solid understanding of SEO best practices including meta tags, semantic HTML, structured data, and performance optimization for search rankings.

• Experience in best practices in application development; including Agile Development, Continuous Integration, Test Driven Development and SOLID principles

• Strong testing focus, be able to write "clean" and "well designed code"

• Familiarity with modern web architectural patterns and state management solutions

• Someone who is not afraid of challenging projects and is open to looking at new ways to resolve them

• Strong verbal and written communication

YOU WILL LOVE WORKING AT DING IF:

• You want your work to mean something. We move real money for real people — families sending support across borders, communities staying connected. You care about that. 

• You thrive with ownership, not instruction. At Ding, you’ll shape the work, not just deliver it. We move fast and trust people to figure things out. 

• You’re energised by complexity. We operate across 160+ countries, 600+ operator relationships and some of the most challenging last-mile infrastructure on the planet. That excites you. 

• You want to work with people who are sharp, direct and genuinely collaborative. No politics, no silos — just a team that gets things done and backs each other. 

• You’re comfortable with ambiguity and know how to make progress anyway. We’re still building the playbook in many areas, and you’re the kind of person who writes it rather than waits for it. 

 

LIFE AT DING:

We’re building something that genuinely matters — and we want the environment to reflect that. You’ll get real ownership from day one, work with a diverse global team across 25+ nationalities, and be part of a culture that is high-performance without being high-ego. 

 

Beyond the work itself, we've designed our benefits around flexibility, longevity, and genuine quality of life. In addition to standard benefits, you'll also receive:

 

✦  YOLO Days & Dingversary Leave 

✦  Work from abroad option (30 days/year) 

✦ Insurance

✦ Wellness programme & regular events 

✦ Learning & development support

✦ A genuinely global team & culture
