Function: Corporate Security

Location: Kushtia, Bangladesh

Reporting to: Country Corporate Security Manager 

Role: Permanent

 

Corporate Security Manager, Leaf

The incumbent is security leader, representing Corporate Security for the Leaf operation Bangladesh and assigned area of responsibility and any other security services as directed. The position provides support to the Corporate Security team in the delivery of the Corporate Security Strategy, and in the provision of support to all JTI Leaf business entities, operations and projects within his specified Area of Responsibility (AOR). This AOR addresses all facets of the security program including development, review and maintenance with a risk-based and cost-effective approach which must add value to the business. Additionally, the position requires ‘hands on’ tactical engagement as required.
                  
Primary responsibilities, include, but are not limited to, risk assessments, crisis management, personnel security, (including all aspects of travel, event and executive security), maintaining and developing effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders within Bangladesh, with outside law enforcement, intelligence and security agencies and business partners, managing and developing security teams, assessment and development of physical security arrangements incorporating the security audit program, background checks, due diligence and investigations. 
        
The incumbent may be called upon to provide security support inside Bangladesh, as directed by Country Corporate Security Manager.

 

As the Corporate Security Manager, you will be responsible for: 

Risk and Crisis Management

• The incumbent assists in identifying, developing, implementing, and maintaining security processes, practices and policies to reduce risk, respond to incidents, and limit exposure and liability through the development and maintenance of a Security Risk Register.  The overriding aim of all strategies and recommendations is to bring value from security for the business and to enable the Bangladesh CS team to meet its operational objectives.  

• The incumbent is an alternate member for the Crisis Management Team.  As such, may be required to provide operational security support during crisis, investigative support as requested, and crisis/incident management training to sites and markets teams. 

• The incumbent assists to identify trends and best practices in the Bangladesh business environment and make recommendations on development of policies and strategies to reduce vulnerability of JTI assets and any other CS responsibility given to him.

People and Asset Security

• Through a network of site security responsible persons and selected vendors, the incumbent manages the implementation of programs and support to ensure the security of executives, employees, stakeholders, visitors, etc. at their place of work and while on business travel within Bangladesh in his assigned area

• Assist in the provision of security support to personnel conducting business for JTI in high-risk environments, to include personal protection, pre-travel or in country security briefings, residential security surveys, special event security, ground and air transportation advice, meet and greet assistance, and advise on special projects.

• The incumbent assists to develop the audit plan and assists in the management of security audits and assessments and follow up recommendations of business operations.

• The incumbent assists the management supply chain security programs within his AOR to protect operations and products while ensuring brand integrity. Provides consultation across his area to minimize supply chain losses, brand erosion in his AOR. The incumbent may be called upon to provide assistance in any place within Bangladesh.

• As directed and in coordination with other functions as appropriate (e.g., Compliance, Corporate Audit, Legal, People & Culture, H&S, GSC), the incumbent will conduct objective investigations of security-related allegations/incidents as required.

Networking

• Internally - maintain and develop effective working relationships with the members of the Leaf management team, and all Leaf factory leads. Develops networks throughout all functions and levels to promote and drive global security initiatives.  Brief Leaf factory leads on the status of security issues and emerging threats as required.

• Externally - develops relationships with high-level law enforcement, business partners, and international counterparts to include inside Bangladesh security agencies, intelligence and private sector counterparts. Engages, for example by membership, in prestigious public and private security associations.

Financial Management

• The incumbent is expected to exercise efficient financial management of the assigned security program which requires planning and presentation of an annual budget (LE, ASP and SAC), updates on budget within regular intervals (outlooks) and providing appropriate reports on YTD actuals and variances.

• Oversee the management of local contracts with security service vendors for guarding operations, technology applications and specialized consulting and investigative support.

 

Requirements:

•
University degree or equivalent professional experience, complemented by demonstrated achievements

•
At least 5 years of relevant experience in military, law enforcement, intelligence, corporate security, or related environments

•
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of additional regional languages would be considered an asset.

•
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Who we are:

Field Nation brings companies and service professionals together through an integrated, easy-to-use platform. Our mission is to help the service delivery industry do great work, and we live that mission by doing great work for the companies and service professionals who depend on us.

 

Why is this role important to Field Nation?

At Field Nation, our Customer Success Managers are more than account managers — they are Trusted Advisors who earn the right to be the partner buyers call before they make a decision. Operating through three lenses — Trusted Advisor, Success Engineer, and Value Manager — the CSM role sits at the intersection of relationship, technical mastery, and commercial impact.

In a world where AI handles what is repeatable, our CSMs own what requires judgment, trust, and relationship. Using AI as a co-pilot — including Claude, Gemini, internal platform data AI tools, and other available resources — our CSMs amplify their impact across a scaled portfolio, catching risk earlier, building stronger cases for value, and showing up to every buyer conversation better prepared than ever before.

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll drive retention, adoption, and growth by building buyer relationships that make Field Nation indispensable — and by becoming the kind of partner your buyers can’t imagine operating without. This position is located in Dhaka, BD and reports to the Manager, Customer Success.

\n

What you'll get to do:As a Trusted Advisor:

• Earn trusted advisor status with your buyers by building genuine, insight-driven relationships — becoming the partner they call before they make a decision, not after an issue has compounded.

• Develop a deep understanding of each buyer’s business model, operational pressures, and definition of success — and use that context to bring recommendations, not just responses.

• Build buyer relationships that enable the proactive sharing of platform best practices, the surfacing of emerging needs, and early identification of risk before it escalates.

As a Success Engineer:

• Maintain practitioner-level knowledge of the Field Nation platform, including features, workflow configurations, and how buyers’ field service operations actually work in practice.

• Deliver customized training and enablement aligned to buyer personas, industry, and company size.

• Use internal platform data AI tools, Claude, and other AI tools to monitor account health, detect adoption gaps, and surface where buyers are leaving value on the table — then translate those signals into practical recommendations.

As a Value Manager:

• Connect platform usage to measurable business outcomes by tracking buyer KPIs like fix rates, efficiency, and SLA compliance.

• Deliver consistent, value-driven touchpoints (including QBRs and solution discussions) that focus on clear objectives rather than just feature tours.

• Proactively identify and qualify expansion opportunities by anchoring them to documented evidence of realized value.

Operations and Advocacy:

• Proactively manage your book of business by leveraging health signals and AI tools to prioritize at-risk accounts.

• Drive buyer initiatives and projects from conception to completion with clear, individual ownership.

• Act as a buyer advocate by channeling feedback through VOC processes and representing Customer Success in cross-functional initiatives.

•  1+ years of experience in Customer Success or equivalent history building customer relationships with a focus on increasing satisfaction, adoption, and retention.

• A Trusted Advisor mindset — the ability to earn buyer trust through credibility, reliability, and genuine understanding of their business, not just the product.

• An AI-forward approach: comfort using AI tools — including internal platform data AI tools, Claude, and others — as daily co-pilots for account research, insight generation, outreach, and meeting preparation.

As Field Nation modernizes its demand engine for ABM and AI, the person in this seat owns the marketing platforms and technology that the rest of the team operates on and the data and analysis that tells leadership whether the model is working. This role is a key strategic partner to Marketing and RevOps, collaborating closely on shared systems, data governance, and revenue process optimization to drive business outcomes. This is a driver role, not an operator role. We need someone who walks in on Monday with three things already underway, who finds the red before anyone else does, and who can pull a clear answer out of a messy data set without being asked twice.

\n

What you'll get to do:Drive the marketing technology ecosystem forward

•
Own and architect the marketing technology ecosystem, including HubSpot, 6sense, ChiliPiper, and AI platforms.

•
Lead the tech roadmap. Bring proposals and recommendations forward proactively—identify where the stack is weak, where capability gaps will limit growth, and where to invest next.

•
Co-own the Marketing tech stack integration with Salesforce in partnership with RevOps Leadership, ensuring architecture protects data integrity and drives efficiency and productivity.

Drive data-backed decisions

•
Build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and analytics infrastructure the team runs on. Anticipate what leadership needs and have it ready.

•
Surface issues early: data anomalies, performance regressions, system risks, conversion drops, attribution breaks. Recommend proposed solutions.

•
Run independent analyses to inform major decisions: campaign performance reviews, ABX play ROI, inbound quality vs. baseline, segment-level conversion patterns. Be the analytical conscience of the team.

Own the marketing data architecture

Marketing database management, audience segmentation, list governance, data hygiene, enrichment strategy.

•
Partner with RevOps team on marketing-to-sales handoff processes, lead management, and shared funnel metrics.

•
Compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and other regulations; opt-in strategy and data privacy controls.

Strategic partnership

•
Strategic partner to the Sr. Director, Revenue Marketing on platform roadmap, budget, capability investments, and overall team and program performance.

•
Peer partner to the marketing managers on platform-dependent program design and shared system surface area.

•
Strategic partner to RevOps leadership on shared Salesforce governance, data hygiene, and cross-functional processes. Meet regularly with RevOps leadership to align priorities, drive business outcomes, and optimize the revenue engine.

Enable the team

•
Coach and enable marketing ICs on platform best practices, tool capabilities, and process discipline.

•
Establish governance frameworks that scale with the org.

Lead documentation, training, and adherence to platform standards.

•
HubSpot (or equivalent MAP) administration and architecture experience. You've built, broken, and rebuilt the MAP stack at scale.

•
Salesforce fluency. You can navigate Salesforce, build reports, debug integrations, and partner productively with RevOps.

•
AI/agent tool experience in production: AgentForce, 6sense AI email agents, conversational AI, or comparable AI-driven marketing tools. Bonus if you've led an AI tool rollout from evaluation through production.

•
Strong analytics rigor. You can pull a clean data set, run an analysis, and present a defensible conclusion without a BI team holding your hand. SQL proficiency or strong reporting tool fluency is required.

•
Demonstrated track record of proactive problem-solving. Specific examples of surfacing issues before they became crises, driving cross-functional decisions with data, or leading platform investments that paid off.

•
Excellent communication. You can document architecture, write a clear executive summary of an analysis, and train others.

•
Experience leading platform consolidation, MAP migration, or significant stack rationalization.

•
Coaching or formal management experience.

•
Two-sided marketplace, services-marketplace, or field-service business experience.

•
AI / automation implementation in marketing operations.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Expert
jobs.description:
• Home

• Jobs

• Cybersecurity Expert

Cybersecurity Expert

Job Type: Full time
No. of Vacancies: 1
Experience: 3 Years

Apply Now

 

Job Context:

We are looking for a hands-on Cybersecurity Expert to take full ownership of information security at Riseup Labs. You will assess our infrastructure, close gaps, put practical controls in place, train our people, lead incident response, and support compliance with SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other frameworks. You will also act as a trusted security voice in client conversations and help grow our cybersecurity offerings.

This is an execution role. We need someone who implements and tests controls, not someone who only writes policies.

Job Responsibilities:

• Security Assessment and Risk Management• Review infrastructure, networks, cloud environments, applications, devices, access controls, and internal practices to identify vulnerabilities and risks.

• Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability assessments, risk assessments, and security reviews, and track findings through to remediation.

• Maintain a risk register with clear priorities, owners, and timelines.

• Security Governance and Controls• Establish and continuously improve company-wide security policies, standards, and controls.

• Work with Technology, IT, DevOps, Compliance, HR, and Delivery teams so that controls are implemented and operating, not just documented.

• Implement and manage security controls such as identity and access management, MFA, endpoint protection, logging and monitoring, patching, backup, and encryption.

• Incident Response• Design and maintain an incident response plan, escalation matrix, and playbooks.

• Lead investigation, containment, recovery, and post-incident reviews for security incidents.

• Run incident-response tabletop exercises and drills.

• Security Awareness and Training• Deliver regular security awareness training and workshops for all employees.

• Plan and run phishing and social-engineering simulations and report on results and improvement.

• Compliance and Assurance• Support SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other security and compliance requirements, including evidence collection, control testing, and audit readiness.

• Map controls to relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls) and drive continuous improvement of our security posture.

• Secure Development and DevSecOps• Partner with engineering and project teams on secure SDLC and security-by-design practices.

• Support secure code review, threat modeling, SAST/DAST, dependency and container scanning, and secrets management in CI/CD pipelines.

• Advise on securing cloud and AI platforms, APIs, and data pipelines.

• Pre-Sales and Business Growth• Join client and pre-sales meetings to understand security requirements and respond to security questionnaires and RFPs.

• Contribute to solution design and proposals with a security component.

• Help define, package, and grow Cybersecurity as a service offering (e.g., assessments, VAPT, compliance readiness, security consulting).

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, information security, or security engineering.

• Proven experience with vulnerability assessment and penetration testing, risk assessment, and security audits.

• Strong knowledge of network security, application security, cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and identity and access management.

• Practical experience with security tools such as SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, OpenVAS), Burp Suite, and Wireshark.

• Hands-on experience with incident response and digital forensics fundamentals.

• Working knowledge of SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and NIST frameworks, with experience supporting at least one audit or certification.

• Familiarity with secure SDLC, DevSecOps, and OWASP Top 10.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain security topics to technical and non-technical audiences, including clients and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, or cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).

• Experience with ISO 27001 implementation or PCI DSS assessment.

• Experience in a software, IT services, or consulting environment.

• Experience securing AI/ML platforms, APIs, and data pipelines.

• Prior pre-sales, client-facing, or security consulting experience.

• Experience with enterprise or government sector security requirements in Bangladesh.

• Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for security automation.

Key Competencies

• Ownership and accountability.

• Hands-on, execution-focused approach.

• Risk-based thinking and sound judgment.

• Cross-functional collaboration.

• Teaching and communication skills.

• Client confidence and professionalism.

• Ability to work calmly under pressure during incidents.

• Uttara, Dhaka

Working hour:

• 9.00 AM to 6.00 PM

• Negotiable (Based on experience and skills)

Compensation and Benifits: (Applicable for Bangladeshi Employee Only)

• Group Life and Health Insurance

• Full Subsidized Lunch/Dinner

jobs.description:
• Home

• IT Infrastructure & Network Lead

IT Infrastructure & Network Lead

Job Type: Full time
No. of Vacancies: 1
Experience: 7 Years

Apply Now

 

Job Context:

Riseup Labs is looking for a hands-on IT Infrastructure & Network Lead who can design, maintain, troubleshoot and secure our complex office network and IT environment.
This is not a purely managerial role. The right person must be able to personally handle: Network design & troubleshooting, Firewall, VPN, routing, VLAN, Active Directory, Windows/Mac/Linux, Storage, backup, endpoint security, Remote access, access control, compliance readiness.

Job Responsibilities:

Network & Security

• Design and maintain office network (routing, switching, VLAN, Wi-Fi, redundancy)

• Manage firewall policies, NAT, VPN tunnels, remote user VPN

• Monitor network performance, uptime, and security incidents

• Ensure secure segmentation for BPO operations (users, teams, departments)

Infrastructure & Systems

• Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, user lifecycle, access control

• Maintain Windows Server services (DNS, DHCP, File Share, Print, etc.)

• Manage endpoint environment for Windows + Mac + Linux

• Ensure patching, antivirus/EDR, vulnerability management

Storage, Backup & Business Continuity

• Maintain file servers, NAS/SAN, backup strategy

• Ensure disaster recovery plan, restore testing, and audit readiness

IT Operations

• Lead IT support team and set proper ticketing + ITSM workflow

• Ensure smooth onboarding/offboarding for 300+ users

• Asset management for laptops, desktops, networking devices, licenses

Remote Team & BPO Support:

• Provide secure access for remote teams

• Ensure high availability for BPO operations and client delivery

• Maintain strong security controls for user access, data protection, and monitoring

Required Skills:

We will prioritize candidates who are proficient in

• Complex office networking (VLAN, routing, switching, Wi-Fi design)

• Firewall + VPN (Fortinet/Mikrotik/Sophos/Cisco/Palo Alto — any)

• Active Directory + Group Policy

• Windows + Linux administration

• Mac support experience (basic to intermediate)

• Storage + backup systems

• Strong troubleshooting ability (real-world production incidents)

Mandatory Requirement (Hands-on Network Hardware):

• Must have current, hands-on experience working with enterprise network hardware (routing, switching, firewall).

• Must have deep hands-on experience with both Cisco and MikroTik (configuration, troubleshooting, VLAN, routing, VPN).

• Candidates who do not have real, in-depth hands-on network implementation experience on Cisco + MikroTik should not apply.

This role includes hands-on configuration and troubleshooting of live office network infrastructure. It is not a purely managerial position.

Nice to Have:

• Experience in BPO, call center, or large user environments

• ISO 27001 / SOC2 readiness experience (not just theory)

• Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure) for hybrid connectivity

• Monitoring tools (Zabbix/PRTG/Grafana/ELK)

• Experience with Zero Trust / MFA / SSO

Experience Requirements:

• Minimum 7+ years in IT Infrastructure / Network / Systems

• At least 2+ years leading IT support/infrastructure team

Axiata PLC

The Manager/senior manager Digitalization &
Autonomous Operation will lead the transformation of network assurance through

•     
Identify and
scale high-value AI and automation opportunities that eliminate repetitive
operational activities, reduce incident resolution time, improve network
reliability, and generate measurable Opex/Capex savings and productivity gains.

Create
executive-grade network intelligence and visibility through Grafana, Power BI,
and advanced analytics platforms, converting complex network data into
actionable insights for proactive operations, faster incident response, and
data-driven business decisions.

•     
Architect
scalable, production-grade AI and assurance services using Python, FastAPI,
Django, microservices, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, and modern data
technologies, enabling rapid deployment and expansion of AI use cases.

•     
Institutionalize
outcome-based engineering KPIs covering automation rate, MTTR, resolution
accuracy, false-positive reduction, network availability, manual-effort
reduction, and Opex/Capex impact—creating measurable accountability for AI and
automation investments.

•     
Drive end-to-end
transformation across business and technology functions, aligning Network
Operations, Engineering, Security, IT, and Business stakeholders around
strategic priorities and converting AI/automation concepts into production
solutions with measurable operational and business impact

 

Preferred
Qualifications

•     
Proven track
record of designing, developing, and deploying production-grade AI/LLM
solutions, including RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, Agentic AI, and
conversational AI.

Strong practical
experience working with EMS/NMS platforms, network KPIs, telemetry, alarms,
performance data, or network/security monitoring systems.

AI/ML & LLM

application development.

equivalent data-warehouse platforms, Pandas, data modeling, and analytics

Bachelor’s degree
in computer science, Telecommunications, or a related field.

jobs.title: Senior SecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior SecOps Engineer

Full time

Dhaka

Employment term Permanent

Category IT security/Networks

Apply now

Job description:
The Senior SecOps Engineer is responsible for protecting SELISE cloud and application environments through security monitoring, threat detection and response, vulnerability management, cloud security, identity and access controls, and security automation. The role works closely with DevOps, engineering, and infrastructure teams to embed security into the software delivery and operational lifecycle.

Job responsibilities

What You Will Do

• You operate and continuously improve security monitoring and threat detection capabilities using Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM/SOAR, EDR, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, and related security platforms.

• You monitor and investigate security alerts, suspicious activity, and potential incidents, and lead or support containment, root-cause analysis, remediation, and incident response.

• You implement and maintain cloud security controls across Azure environments, including IAM/RBAC, privileged access, service identities, Key Vault/secrets, networking, and access-management controls.

• You secure AKS/Kubernetes clusters, Docker containers, cloud-native workloads, networking, secrets, and container images.

• You manage vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation tracking, security hardening, CVE response, VAPT activities, and penetration-testing remediation.

• You integrate security controls and automated security checks into CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows and develop automation tooling to reduce manual investigation and response effort.

• You support Terraform/IaC security, policy-as-code, security architecture reviews, and security-by-design practices across multi-environment enterprise cloud platforms.

• You maintain security documentation, procedures, incident records, and audit evidence, and support controls related to ISO 27001 and GDPR.

• You collaborate closely with DevOps, developers, architects, infrastructure teams, and management to communicate security risks and remediation priorities.

• You embed security requirements, reviews, testing, and risk-mitigation controls across each phase of the enterprise application development lifecycle

Required qualifications

Who You Are

• You have 5+ years of experience in Security Operations, Cloud Security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, or a related field.

• You have a strong understanding of security operations, threat detection, incident response, security monitoring, vulnerability management, CVEs, security hardening, and remediation.

• You have hands-on experience with Azure security services and cloud security architecture, and practical knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel or another SIEM platform.

• You have strong knowledge of IAM/RBAC, networking, identity, privileged access, secrets management, Key Vault, and access-control concepts.

• You have experience securing Kubernetes/AKS, Docker containers, cloud-native workloads, and container images.

• You understand VAPT and penetration-testing findings and can drive practical remediation.

• You have knowledge of DevSecOps, secure SDLC, CI/CD security integration, Terraform/IaC security, and policy-as-code.

• You have scripting and automation skills using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar tools.

• You understand security standards and controls such as ISO 27001 and GDPR and are familiar with SIEM/SOAR, EDR, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, and security automation platforms.

• You bring a security-first, automation-oriented approach, proactively identify and remediate risks, and communicate incidents, security risks, and remediation priorities clearly.

• You have strong analytical, incident-management, communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Relevant cloud or security certifications, such as Azure Security Engineer, Security Operations, or equivalent, are an advantage

Additional information

What You Can Expect

• A competitive salary and growth-oriented career path.

• A collaborative environment with supportive peers, mentors, and a strong engineering culture.

• Opportunities to participate in innovation initiatives, architecture discussions, and technical leadership.

• Continuous learning through training, knowledge sharing, and hands-on challenges.

• Team building events and recreational activities.

• Plenty of scope to experiment, innovate, and make a real impact

Professional skills

Docker
Kubernetes
SIEM
Azure
CI/CD

The Role:

As Software Engineer, Backend, you will be integral to building, scaling, and maintaining our microservices architecture, driving the performance and reliability of our core platform. The ideal candidate should possess a strong background in backend engineering and system design - particularly in Golang - demonstrate exceptional problem-solving abilities, and exhibit enthusiasm for actively contributing to the achievements of the leading startup within the EdTech sector of Bangladesh.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Owning assigned microservices end-to-end on a quarterly basis across our fleet of 30+ services (e.g., live class, core, gateway, live exam, machinary, kpi, analytics, anubadok, Shikho AI).
• Designing and building scalable, high-throughput microservices in Golang with comprehensive test coverage.
• Hands-on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) engineering: building and maintaining retrieval pipelines, embedding stores, and evaluation datasets for AI-powered services (e.g., anubadok, Shikho AI).
• Debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues, while optimizing endpoint performance and overall system health.
• Translating product and platform requirements into robust technical architectures and participating in technical design discussions.
• Representing the Backend platform in cross-platform API design (REST/GraphQL) and collaboration with Mobile and Product teams.
• Maintaining complete technical documentation, service specifications, and system diagrams for owned microservices.
• Working in an AI-native engineering environment using agentic IDEs and coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to deliver daily agent-generated diffs.
• Leveraging AI assistance to generate unit tests, test fixtures, database migration scripts, and run efficient production log analysis for root-cause hypothesis generation.
• Utilizing AI tools to draft PR descriptions, RFCs, technical documentation, and service runbooks following team playbooks.
• Contributing to AI context engineering (prompts, agent skills, context files) and workflow optimization for cost-effective AI utilization.
• Participating in code reviews, sharing effective AI prompt workflows, and mentoring junior engineers.
• Coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure strict deadlines and sprint planning guidelines are met.
• Working collaboratively within the engineering team to offer support whenever needed to achieve system objectives.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Minimum 3–4 years of professional experience in backend software development, with a core focus on distributed microservices architectures.
• Proven track record of designing, building, and delivering high-volume, low-latency microservices and API endpoints.
• Strong proficiency in the specified tech stack: Golang, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ArangoDB, Redis, REST/GraphQL, Docker, and Weaviate (vector search/RAG).
• Hands-on experience or deep familiarity with AI/RAG architectures, including embedding stores, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and model evaluation datasets.
• Experience writing comprehensive test suites (unit/integration), managing test fixtures, and handling database migration strategies.
• Demonstrable adaptability to an AI-native workflow, with familiarity using agentic IDEs (Cursor/Claude Code), context engineering, prompt optimization, and daily AI-assisted shipping.
• Exceptional problem-solving skills, root-cause debugging capabilities (log analysis), and a metrics-driven approach to service health and latency optimization.
• Strong collaborative skills to translate technical specifications into clean designs and represent backend architectures across multi-team discussions.

The Important Bits:

- Job type: Full Time

- Department: Technology - Engineering

- Work Location: HQ, Banani, Dhaka

- Salary: Competitive and Negotiable Based on Experience

- Working Days: 5 days a week, from Sunday to Thursday

jobs.title: Executive/Sr. Executive, Visual Design
jobs.description:
The Role:

Shikho is looking for a powerhouse Executive/Sr. Executive, Visual Design to join our brand team. This role requires a hybrid creative who possesses both the strategic eye of a Visualizer and the technical prowess of a Motion Designer and Animator. You will bridge the gap between abstract academic concepts, brand stories, and high end visual execution taking complete ownership of the visual journey across our social media platforms, app, digital products, and websites to make learning hyper engaging for students.

Key Responsibilities:

Visual Ideation & Storyboarding

• Think creatively to develop original design concepts, graphics, layouts, and style frames from raw briefs or eLearning storyboards

• Analyze complex academic content and translate it into clear, engaging, and age appropriate visual representations

• Ensure strong visual continuity across all media by strictly adhering to and expanding Shikho brand and design guidelines

Multidimensional Motion & Asset Creation

• Animate everything from complex scientific concepts and custom characters to sleek UI motion and promotional campaign assets

• Create original 2D/3D graphics, character designs, environments, dynamic typography, and asset libraries from scratch

• Mix media seamlessly by compositing 2D/3D elements with real world footage, CGI, and tracking for brand films and app content

Omnichannel Design & UX Alignment

• Visualize and design user screens, digital assets, and marketing creatives optimized for social media, the Shikho app, and web interfaces

• Create production ready visual guidelines, toolkits, and design systems to maintain consistency across all student touchpoints

• Stay ahead of global EdTech and motion trends, proactively proposing creative and technical upgrades to elevate our content

Workflow Ownership & Collaboration

• Partner cross functionally with academic, copywriter, product, digital marketing, and the broader brand team to ensure visual assets are both educationally accurate and aesthetically compelling

• Take full accountability for the design to animation pipeline from initial brief and conceptual visualization to final render and export with minimal supervision

• Optimize production efficiency by exploring new software, plugins, scripts, and visual shortcuts in a fast paced environment

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in a top digital marketing agency, high growth tech company, or EdTech brand

• Dual Expertise: A portfolio that clearly demonstrates both high level static visualization like layout, typography, branding, and illustration alongside advanced motion design and animation skills

• The Toolkit: Expert level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite including After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Character Animator and 3D software like Cinema 4D or Blender

• EdTech Context: Prior experience in EdTech or visual learning content design is highly preferred

• Execution & Drive: Proven ability to take full ownership of projects under tight campaign deadlines while upholding premium visual standards

• Communication: Strong ability to pitch concepts, justify visual choices, and collaborate across technical and non technical teams
• Application Requirement: You are required to attach a portfolio link showcasing both visual design and layout as well as motion graphics and animation with your application

The Important Bits:

- Job type: Full Time

- Department: Brand Marketing

- Location: Banani, Dhaka, Bangladesh

- Working Days: 5 days a week, from Sunday to Thursday

jobs.description:
The Role:

As an Android Developer (Sr. Software Engineer) at Shikho, you will be integral to creating and maintaining high-quality mobile applications, enhancing user experiences, and ensuring the seamless functionality of our platform. The ideal candidate should possess a strong background in Android development technologies, demonstrate exceptional problem-solving abilities, and exhibit enthusiasm for actively contributing to the achievements of the leading startup within the EdTech sector of Bangladesh.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

• Designing and building scalable, performant Android features used by hundreds of thousands of learners.

• Responsible for Android app architecture, modularization, build pipeline, and the Play Store release process.

• Managing end-to-end feature delivery for assigned modules on a quarterly basis.

• Writing production-grade Kotlin with comprehensive unit and instrumented test coverage.

• Translating product requirements into robust technical designs.

• Representing the Android platform in cross-platform API design and collaboration with the Backend team.

• Own app quality metrics including startup time, rendering performance, crash-free users, and ANR rate.

• Work in an AI-native engineering environment using agentic IDEs and coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex)

• Leveraging AI assistance to generate unit tests, edge cases, migration scripts, and perform efficient debugging.

• Utilizing AI tools to draft PR descriptions, RFCs, and engineering documentation.

• Contributing to AI context engineering (prompts, agent skills, context files) and workflow optimization for cost-effective AI use.

• Participating in code reviews and training junior engineers within the team on the team's AI workflows and sharing effective prompts.

• Coordinating with various teams working on distinct layers.

• Ensuring you work to strict deadlines and maintain proper sprint planning guidelines.

• Working as a team member and offering to help out as and when necessary, in other tasks pertaining to the development of the technology solution.

• Will be involved from conception to completion with projects that are technologically sound and aesthetically impressive.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Minimum 3-6 years of professional experience in mobile application development, with a core focus on the Android ecosystem.

• Proven track record of designing, building, and delivering high-volume, low-latency features in a professional setting.

• Deep understanding of Android app architecture, modularization strategies, build pipelines, and Play Store delivery.

• Strong proficiency in the specified tech stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, Hilt, Retrofit, Room, Firebase, and GitHub.

• Experience writing comprehensive test coverages including unit and instrumented tests.

• Demonstrable adaptability to an AI-native workflow, with familiarity utilizing agentic IDEs (Cursor/Claude Code), context engineering, and AI prompt optimization.

• Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a metrics-driven approach to tracking application health (ANRs, crashes).

• Strong collaborative skills to translate product specs into designs and represent mobile architectures during cross-platform API discussions.

Education

• Experience in Liability Marketing or Deposit Mobilization from any reputed Commercial Bank will be considered as added advantage.

• Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills

• Sound knowledge of CASA, FDR, deposit pricing and liability products

• Ability to build relationships with senior corporate and institutional decision-makers

• Target-oriented, with pipeline and portfolio management ability

• Good understanding of banking operations, KYC and AML/CFT requirements

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Proficiency in MS Office and MIS tools

Responsibilities & Context

Senior Relationship Officer/Relationship Officer-Liability Marketing Unit (LMU) will be responsible for achieving assigned deposit mobilization targets, with primary focus on CASA, through acquiring new customers, and growing existing relationships across corporate, institutional, government, SME and high-net-worth segments.

The role involves building and maintaining a strong customer base, promoting the bank’s liability products, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines. This is a target based position requiring strong communication, negotiation skills and a result oriented mindset to contribute to the bank’s overall business growth.

Deposit Mobilization: Achieve assigned CASA and overall deposit targets, prioritizing low-cost CASA while generating quality FDR and other deposits where appropriate.

Customer Acquisition: Identify, approach and onboard New-to-Bank customers from corporate, multinational, government, institutional, SME and HNI segments.

Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers, conduct regular client visits, understand customer needs and offer suitable liability solutions.

Pipeline & Sales Planning: Maintain an updated prospect database and sales pipeline, prepare monthly/quarterly/annual sales plans, follow up on leads, and track proposals through to fund placement.

Associate - Human Resources (Organizational Development)

Application Deadline :

13 Oct 2026

• Vacancy:01

Published: 04 Oct 2026

Requirements

Education

• Bachelor/Honors

Experience

• • 2 to 5 years

• The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Banks

Additional Requirements

• Age 25 to 35 years

• Relevant experience in HR/OD/PMS/L&D/Talent Management, preferably within the banking or financial services sector.      

• Proficient in MS Office, with strong command of MS Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis and dashboard/report preparation).

•  Sound understanding of KPI and competency-based Performance Management concepts.

• Strong analytical, coordination and communication skills, with high attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality

Responsibilities & Context

Mutual Trust Bank PLC. (MTB) is one of Bangladesh's leading private commercial banks, committed to delivering innovative, customer-centric financial solutions. We foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, and excellence, empowering our people to grow while creating lasting value for our customers and communities.

Job grade: Officer - Senior Officer

Key Responsibilities

Organization Development (OD)

• Support the review and maintenance of organizational structures, organograms, and manpower planning across CHO Divisions/Departments and Branches.

• Assist in standardizing Job Descriptions (JD), Job Objectives (JO), and the JD–JO–KPI framework in line with Bank-approved guidelines.

• Coordinate and maintain documentation for Gender Diversity & Inclusion and other Bank-wide OD initiatives.

• Support Assessment Centre and Development Centre activities, including scheduling, data compilation, coordination, and reporting.

Performance Management System (PMS)

• Support the administration of MTB's KPI- and competency-based Performance Management System.

• Assist in setting, reviewing, and communicating JO-KPIs across the Bank.

• Coordinate the KPI sign-off process and half-yearly review/rating cycle.

• Maintain records of employee-supervisor KPI agreements and performance-related documentation.

• Support the annual performance appraisal cycle, rating calibration, and timely completion of performance reviews.

Learning & Development (L&D)

• Support the planning, coordination, and execution of training and development programs.

• Assist in preparing training proposals, training notes, and related documentation.

• Support the rollout of the Corporate Leadership Development Program (CLDP) and other capability-building initiatives.

• Coordinate with internal and external trainers/institutes for scheduling, logistics, and post-training activities.

• Maintain training records and MIS and support measurement of training effectiveness and ROI.

Talent Management (TM)

• Support succession planning and leadership competency mapping initiatives.

• Coordinate Management Trainee (MMT) program administration and related talent pipeline activities.

• Support professional certification and development initiatives for HR team members and identified talent pools.

• Assist in maintaining talent management databases, reports, and HR analytics.

Skills & Expertise

jobs.description:
Assistant Manager - Service Integration

Application Deadline :

18 Oct 2026

• Vacancy:1

Location: Dhaka

Salary:Negotiable

Experience:• 3 to 5 years

Published: 07 Oct 2026

Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Requirements

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, MIS, IT or related discipline.

Experience

• • 3 to 5 years

• The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Banks, Financial Technology (Fintech) Startup, Telecommunication

Additional Requirements

Skills Requirements:  

• Strong understanding of system integration principles, API-based integrations, and service delivery processes. 

• Understanding system integration concepts, including APIs, authentication, data flows, and inter‑system dependencies. 

• Ability to evaluate and plan API-based integrations, including payload structures, request/response patterns, and expected transaction volumes. 

• Understanding of Data Center, Application, Database, Network, Infrastructure, and Cloud Migration approaches, including cutover, rollback, and business continuity considerations. 

• Ability to analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into integration and implementation activities. 

• Experience in creating and managing release plans with focus on timelines, dependencies, and integration impacts. 

• Familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile, Scrum, testing, and release management practices. 

• Strong command of project and planning tools (Jira, Trello, MS Project, Confluence) for tracking deliverables and timelines. 

• Knowledge of service delivery frameworks, including SLA design, performance baselines, and end‑to‑end service health. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a cross-functional environment. 

Additional Requirements: 

• Strong communication, negotiation, interpersonal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. 

• Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and fast-paced technology environments. 

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. 

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives, competing priorities, and stakeholder expectations simultaneously. 

• 3-5 years in Service integration, service delivery or technology environments

• Experience in Digital Financial Services (DFS), FinTech, Banking, Telecommunications, Payment Systems, or Technology organizations will be preferred. 

Responsibilities & Context

• Coordinate end-to-end onboarding activities for merchants, partners, vendors, government organizations, banks, billers, and other ecosystem participants to ensure successful service integration and implementation.

• Coordinate integration activities, including interface validation, connectivity readiness, testing coordination, and alignment between internal teams and external stakeholders for Bill Payment, Add Money, Merchant Payment, E-Commerce, Government Services, Fund Transfer, and other ecosystem services.

• Liaise with government entities, banks, merchants, vendors, partners, service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of integration-related deliverables, approvals, commitments, and dependencies.

• Review and analyze business requirements, API specifications, workflow diagrams, solution designs, and technical documents to support integration planning and implementation activities.

• Assess integration feasibility, technical dependencies, operational impacts, security considerations, and implementation readiness for new services, products, and enhancements.

• Prepare and maintain project and integration-related documentation, including BRD, SRS, FRS, API specifications, workflow diagrams, implementation plans, operational procedures, and integration inventories.

• Support project planning, sprint coordination, backlog management, task tracking, milestone monitoring, and implementation governance activities using project management and collaboration tools.

• Coordinate SIT, UAT, Pilot Testing, Production Validation, and defect management activities to ensure service readiness, quality compliance, and successful implementation.

• Coordinate release, deployment, migration, cutover, and Go-Live activities while ensuring timely communication, stakeholder alignment, and implementation readiness.

• Support operational readiness, change management, transition planning, knowledge transfer, and service handover activities prior to commercial launch.

• Track and facilitate resolution of integration issues, incidents, risks, dependencies, and action items by coordinating with relevant business, operational, and technical teams.

• Maintain integration inventories, project records, implementation trackers, service documentation, release records, and management reports using Jira, Confluence, Trello, MS Project, and Microsoft Office tools.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying integration process gaps, automation opportunities, onboarding inefficiencies, and service enhancement recommendations.

Skills & Expertise

Other Relevant Skills

Compensation & Other Benefits

• Provident fund,Mobile bill,Weekly 2 holidays,Insurance

• Salary Review: Yearly

• Festival Bonus: 2

Work at office

RM/SRM- Corporate Banking (SEO-VP)

25 Oct 2026

• Vacancy:--

Experience:• At least 5 years

Published: 06 Oct 2026

Requirements

Education

• MBA/MBM/Masters/Four years’ Bachelor Degree (preferably Business) from UGC approved universities having no 3rd class in academic records.

• Candidate having minimum 16 years of schooling will be eligible.

• Candidates having professional certification in Islamic Banking will be given preference.

Experience

• • At least 5 years

• The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Banks

Additional Requirements

• Minimum 05 years of banking experience, including at least 03 years in corporate banking in any commercial banks/ financial institution.        

• Candidates currently serving in any Shariah-based bank will be given preference.      

• Preference will be given to candidates having an MTO/PO background or who have been recruited through a competitive examination in any commercial bank or financial institution.

Responsibilities & Context

• Identify, acquire and onboard new corporate clients to expand the bank’s customer base, ensuring alignment with the bank’s business strategy.

• Build, nurture and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with corporate clients, ensuring superior service, satisfaction and retention.

• Drive business by expanding the customer base and achieving targets for loans/ investments & deposit by cross-selling and up-selling appropriate banking products and services tailored to client needs.

• Conduct regular visits to existing and prospective clients to strengthen relationships, explore opportunities and provide proactive solutions.

• Address and resolve client concerns promptly, ensuring a seamless and one-stop banking experience.

• Perform financial analysis, assess creditworthiness and prepare credit/ investment proposals to support sound lending decisions.

• Monitor portfolio quality, minimize NPLs to ensure sustainable asset growth and asset quality, enforce adherence to bank policies, credit/ investment standards and regulatory guidelines.

• Prepare and review credit/ investment proposal/ call reports/ office notes/ memos, maintain accurate MIS and ensure proper documentation and archiving of client files.

• Provide updates on business, industry and regulatory developments to senior management for informed decision-making.

• Liaise effectively with internal teams (credit/ investment, operations, compliance, audit, etc.) and external stakeholders to ensure smooth operations and timely service delivery.

• Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by management to support the smooth functioning of the department.

About Avery Dennison

Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8.9 billion. Learn more at www.averydennison.com. AVERY DENNISON IS PROUD TO BE CERTIFIED GREAT PLACE TO WORK IN AUSTRALIA, BANGLADESH, CHINA, INDIA, INDONESIA, MALAYSIA, SINGAPORE, THAILAND AND VIETNAM, AND RECOGNIZED AS ONE OF THE BEST COMPANIES TO WORK FOR IN ASIA IN GREATER CHINA AND VIETNAM.

Job Description

About the role

The Manager, Production oversees and optimizes daily manufacturing operations to ensure customer orders are delivered within required lead times. This role leads operational output, machine and labor utilization, process improvements, sample development, quality standards, and continuous safety compliance across production departments.

Key Responsibilities

• Coordinate with supervisors and planners to ensure customer orders and priority shipments are delivered according to promised lead times and dates.

• Execute Capex planning aligned with operational forecasting and manage cost evaluations within Oracle.

• Enforce quality systems and procedures to meet required standards, conducting root cause analyses and implementing corrective actions for failures.

• Optimize machine and personnel utilization in collaboration with planners and supervisors to maximize production output, UEE, and UPLH.

• Provide technical and administrative support to achieve targeted sampling lead times, high quality, and new sample developments in partnership with GPD.

• Evaluate best practices across key sites to implement new processes, improve contribution margins, and establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Apply and instruct Lean problem-solving approaches with supervisors and operators to address production-related issues.

• Drive cost savings and sustainable engineering projects to optimize material utilization, reduce scrap, and achieve target productivity levels.

• Collaborate with pre-press, supply chain, material planning, and maintenance teams to ensure uninterrupted production, TPM execution, automation, new machine installations, and product deployments.

• Oversee health and safety requirements, multi-skilling initiatives, departmental discipline, housekeeping, and cross-functional operational coverage.

Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Industrial & Production Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering field.

• Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in production and manufacturing operations.

• Sound and thorough understanding of manufacturing processes and operational management.

• Strong technical, leadership, and decision-making capabilities.

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

• Proven ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.

• Demonstrated experience in Lean manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and root cause analysis.

• Familiarity with ERP systems (Oracle) and production planning tools.

Additional Information

jobs.title: Analyst, IT Cyber Security
jobs.description:
Who we are

Gildan is a leading apparel manufacturing company, with a strong portfolio of brands, including Gildan®, American Apparel®, Comfort Colors®, GOLDTOE®, Peds®, and under the Under Armour® brand through a sock licensing agreement. With close to four decades of developing global manufacturing expertise, Gildan is one of the world’s most efficient, ethical, and sustainable apparel manufacturers. Founded in Canada, Gildan operates out of roughly 30 locations worldwide and sells its products in 60+ markets globally. Together with its 50,000+ employees, Gildan operates with a proven commitment to industry-leading Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) practices throughout its supply chain in accordance with its comprehensive ESG program embedded in the Company's long-term business strategy. More about the company at gildancorp.com.

The opportunity

As an Information Security Advisor, you'll play a pivotal role in strengthening Gildan’s security posture by actively participating in various security operations tasks. This includes but is not limited to monitoring and responding to security incidents and alerts in a timely manor, acting as application and systems administrators for various security tools, working with other teams to provide information security guidance as it relates to policies and procedures, assisting with troubleshooting technical issues, and compiling security related reports containing key performance indicators (KPI’s) related to the day-to-day operations of the Information Security team.

The role

• Gather and prepare monthly reports for information security metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

• Follow-up with cross-functional IT teams on vulnerabilities status and remediations.

• Review, track and triage on day-to-day security alerts and incidents reports:

• Malware protection incidents raised by MSSP

• Antispam alerts and phishing incidents

• Endpoints protection and antivirus alerts

• Alerts from security event monitoring systems

• Apply defined response procedures:

• Follow-up with the local teams on identified security incidents

• Incident response and investigation assistance

• Review, evaluate and report on IT security exceptions request.

• Provide day-to-day operational support for corporate technical security solution (Antivirus, EDR, antispam and web filters,).

• Assist evaluating and implementing system-wide technical security solutions.

• Provide operational assistance reviewing recorded changes to IT system.

• Monitor and gather relevant security news, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats.

• Provide clear, concise security reports on news and vulnerabilities to the Information Security team.

• Ensure timely updates to the appropriate technical teams regarding critical vulnerabilities and threats.

• Advocate for the application of security policies and standards to local teams, promoting compliance with corporate security guidelines.

• Provide clear shift handovers to the local team, including relevant security updates and, ongoing incident status.

• Gather evidence of IT controls execution to support compliance with IT policies and standards.

The requirement

Knowledge & Professional Experience

• 3+ years of global IT experience.

• 2+ years in information security or a related role.

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field preferred. However, relevant skills and experience will be considered.

• Information security certifications (e.g., GIAC, CEH) or other tech certifications are a plus.

Attributes

• Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and take responsibility.

• Strong teamwork and communication skills for collaboration with different teams and stakeholders.

• Problem-solving mindset with a keen interest in information security.

• Knowledgeable in enterprise email antivirus, malware protection, EDR, and antispam systems.

• Understanding in networking concepts and standard network protocols like HTTP, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP.

• Proficient in using data analysis tools, such as Excel, for security data analysis.

• Proficient in troubleshooting computer hardware and software.

• Committed to staying updated with technology trends.

• Familiarity with scripting and basic programming (e.g., PowerShell and SQL) is a plus.

• Flexibility with working hours as needed to accommodate local schedules and time zone differences.

What's in it for you?

• Join a publicly traded company dual-listed on NYSE and TSX with great potential

• Be part of a workplace where meaningful connections and teamwork are celebrated

• From local to international, be ready to work alongside a diverse group of colleagues

• Benefit from mentorship and continuous development opportunities

• Take advantage of our attractive benefits packages

You don't meet all criteria outlined above? Include your transferrable skills and unique experience in your application!

We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

Come as you are:

Join a company that recognizes the importance of diversity, equity, and inclusion to create a successful and collaborative work environment. As an equal-opportunity employer, we value and embrace all the characteristics that make you uniquely you and seek to provide everyone with an equal chance to succeed. Because equity and inclusion matter at Gildan.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Syngenta headquartered in Basel, Switzerland and is among the world's leading companies in Agriculture Crop Protection and ranks in the top 3 in the high value commercial Seeds market. In Syngenta we are helping to improve global food security by enabling millions of farmers to make better use of available resources. Through world class science and innovative crop solutions, our 48,000 people in over 100 countries are working to transform how crops are grown. We are committed to rescuing land from degradation, enhancing biodiversity and revitalizing rural communities.

Join Syngenta and help build the most collaborative and trusted team in agriculture. No matter what your position, you will have a vital role to play in safely feeding the world and taking care of our planet.

Job Description

Role Purpose:

• Lead country Finance team with ownership of all Commercial, Business, administrative responsibilities, Financial Planning and Analysis, Monthly Business Review (MBR) and Business Decision Support. 

• Provide financial leadership and guidance to Country Leadership Team, Build and manage effective relationships with key business partners to better influence and shape business priorities.

Accountabilities:

• Identify clearly business opportunities and set ambitious targets accordingly that translates into areas for business focus, resources allocation and high-quality business planning input.

• Contribute through analysis and controlling process to the operational and strategic performance and growth of both Crop Protection and Seeds business. Through detailed financial analysis of key financial information, provide management with facts and data based impartial financial advice.

• Provide business with sound risk-based analysis on potential impacts, implications and propose potential ways to improve risk management on key economic exposures, in partnership with the business define, implement and monitor key performance metrics

• For all key investment decisions, provide accurate and informative appraisals that drive trade-off discussion and appropriate resource allocation.

• Lead the annual Budget process, rolling forecasts, and the long-term planning.

• Serve as a Board Member of Syngenta Bangladesh, accomplish all the board related task as the regulatory/statutory requirement. Ownership of statutory and fiscal representation by managing and overseeing the preparation of statutory, tax and management reports in accordance with local GAAP, Tax regulations and Group Reporting standards.

• Provide the linkage between the Country and Regional Finance organizations, ensuring timely, accurate, effective and transparent flow of information and data.

• Support and partner with Finance Operation Team in Pune, India in the implementation and delivery of best-in-class accounting and financial support to the country.

• Drive Compliance Culture in the organization.

• Develop, coach, guide Finance team and inspire to be an agile and high performing team.

Qualifications

Critical Experience:

• Minimum 15 years’ experience all facets of accounting and business partnering role.

• Proven capability to communicate and manage complex issues.

• Involvement in strategic options development and implementation.

• Familiarity with a computerized business environment (e.g. ERP software, Enterprise Data Warehouse).

Critical Knowledge​​​​​​​:

• P&L drive, finance business partnering including GTM, pricing, portfolio, price/ volume trade-off.

• Strong knowledge of TFCM, credit functions and commercial terms.

• Advanced knowledge of Financial Reporting Standard and GAAP.

• Understanding of Business Financial planning cycles.

• Strong Business Case analysis and ability to analyse trade off decisions, think “ROI”. 

• Strong knowledge of internal controls and local statutory and tax regulations.

Critical Capabilities:​​​​​​​

• Certified Public Accountant, MBA preferred

• An aptitude for detailed, inquisitiveness as to the drivers of production and financial performance

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, strong stakeholders’ management

• Strong persuasion power, communicate with impact, able to influence non-finance functions

• Advanced financial analysis tools and techniques

• Develop goals and prioritize actions

• Understand well supply chain processes

• Communicate effectively

• Step beyond comfort zones

• Take ownership for the change

• Achieve goals and standards

• Manage performance to ensure high results

• Coach to release creativity and innovation

Additional Information

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Collaborate and communicate with other teams during incident resolution, escalate when necessary, and provide comprehensive documentation of the issue.

•
Continuously review and update monitoring configurations, alert thresholds, and escalation procedures to adapt to changes in the infrastructure and application landscape.

Requirements:

• Basic understanding of Linux operating systems and command-line interface is required.

•
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

•
Willingness to work in shifts, ensuring 24x7x365 coverage (nights, weekends, and holidays) and be available for Oncall duties as required.

•
Familiarity with monitoring and diagnostic tools, such as log analyzers, performance monitoring applications, and network analysis tools.

•
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

By joining the Oncall Operations Team as a specialist, you will play a significant role in ensuring the continued smooth operation of our critical systems, contributing to the overall success of our organization.

jobs.title: DevOps Administrator
jobs.description:
DevOps Admin (Hands-On Role | 1–3 Years)

We are hiring a DevOps Admin (1–3 Years Experience) to join our growing team. This is a hands-on role focused on supporting and improving real production environments.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly with Linux systems, troubleshooting JVM-based applications, and applying practical SRE principles to enhance system reliability and performance. You should enjoy debugging issues, identifying root causes, and continuously improving infrastructure.

Exposure to containerization technologies (such as Docker or similar platforms) and modern DevOps practices is highly desirable.

If you are motivated, analytical, and eager to grow in a production-focused DevOps environment, we’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll be working on

 

•
Linux administration: Day-to-day management, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and basic system hardening

•
Java application environments: Supporting Java-based applications and working with web and application servers

•
CI/CD pipelines: Helping improve and maintain build and deployment pipelines; automating repetitive tasks where possible

•
Production debugging: Investigating failed deployments, performance issues, and unexpected behavior by digging into logs and system metrics

•
Scripting: Writing and maintaining scripts—mostly Bash, with some Python where it makes sense

•
Production support: Participating in releases and handling off-hours issues when required (shared across the team)

What we’re looking for

 

• B.Sc in CSE/EEE/ Related technical field.

•
1–3 years of experience in DevOps, system administration, or a similar role

•
Strong Linux fundamentals and comfort working from the command line

•
Practical troubleshooting and analytical skills

•
Basic understanding of JVM-based applications (memory usage, logs, common failure patterns)

•
Willingness to learn, take ownership, and work through problems instead of avoiding them

 

Nice to have

 

•
Exposure to Docker and/or Kubernetes (home labs count)

•
Experience with monitoring or observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or similar

•
Any experience supporting production systems

This role offers solid exposure to real production environments, a supportive team, and room to grow deeper into DevOps engineering over time.

jobs.title: Engineer, Network Operations
jobs.description:
About the Role

Responsible for ensuring network availability, reliability, performance, and security through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident management, and maintenance. Support network operations across data centers, enterprise networks, remote sites, and partner environments.

Job Location: Jessore

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor and ensure roster of network operations, connectivity, availability, and performance across data centers, enterprise networks, third-party/partner networks, and remote sites.

• Configure, manage, and troubleshoot IP networks, routers, switches, firewalls, LAN, wireless networks, VPNs, and related network infrastructure.

• Work with TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Ethernet, VLAN, STP, LACP, BGP, OSPF, static routing, and network security technologies to troubleshoot and maintain network connectivity.

• Support data center networking and high-availability requirements, including DC/DR and new-site network readiness, traffic switchover, and service migration.

• Manage and troubleshoot firewall and VPN technologies, including IPsec, IKE, NAT, and enterprise firewall platforms.

• Monitor network health and performance using tools such as Cacti, Smokeping, Grafana, and SolarWinds, and perform packet-level troubleshooting using Wireshark where required.

• Coordinate with connectivity vendors, third-party partners, product vendors, and OEMs for network onboarding, implementation, troubleshooting, and technical support.

• Manage network assets and inventory, Linux/UNIX platform configuration requirements, and contribute to network optimization and automation initiatives.

Jobholder Requirements

Education:

• Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or Computer Science & Engineering (CS/CSE).

Experience:

• 1–2 years Hands-on experience in IP network configuration and management, routing and switching, and router, switch, and firewall configuration.

Additional Requirments:

• Experience managing LAN, wireless networks, site-to-site and user VPNs, and network monitoring solutions.

• Working knowledge of SDN, SD-Access, SD-WAN, network asset and inventory management, and Linux/UNIX platforms.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across network, operating system, and hardware environments, with knowledge of server, storage, networking, routing, security, and port-channel technologies.

• Basic understanding of network automation using Python, Ansible, or APIs will be an advantage.

• Strong understanding of TCP/IP, VLAN, STP, LACP, BGP, OSPF, VPN, DNS, DHCP, NTP, SNMP, Syslog, NetFlow, and network monitoring.

• Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches and familiarity with enterprise firewall platforms such as Cisco, Palo Alto, Check Point, or similar platforms.

• Experience with Wireshark and packet-level troubleshooting.

• Vendor certifications such as CCNA/CCNP or RHCE, or certifications related to server, storage, and backup, will be preferred.
